tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Cream is the default; charcoal only for one feature section per page (Academy).

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, alternating sections on ground.

tokens.name: ground-stone
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate section background (venue, footer bands).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, outlines of cards and inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, ground-raised and ground-stone (13:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on any ground (5.5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: PT7 gold. Fills only: primary buttons, lane 7 in the track art, the 7-stripe. Never as text on cream.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Hover on gold fills; the 7 of the logo on cream.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold-coloured text: eyebrow lines, links (5:1 on cream, 11:1 on charcoal).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on gold, strength and yoga fills.

tokens.name: strength
tokens.usage: Strength discipline accent: the 7-stripe on strength coaches and lanes. Fills only.

tokens.name: yoga
tokens.usage: Yoga discipline accent: the 7-stripe on yoga coaches and lanes. Fills only.

tokens.name: flame-core
tokens.usage: Centre of the 1928 flame illustration (venue story only).

tokens.name: flame-edge
tokens.usage: Sides of the 1928 flame illustration.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px gap.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline. Light, sentence case. One key word may be set in medium (500).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings. Light, sentence case, last word or phrase in medium.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: The medium-weight words inside a light headline. Never a whole headline.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Line above a headline, in gold-text. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Seven ways to train, one coach beside you.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter, card gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between logo lockups; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Heading to content.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (72px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, photos. Square corners.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, outline buttons, line-art strokes.

tokens.name: logo-stroke
tokens.usage: Logo stroke at its 480-unit drawing size; line art should feel this light.
